svg.text: Independent randomized rounds produce guide trees; the original tagged families alone determine the final speciation-triplet score.
ROOTED GENE FAMILIES → DISCO FOREST → BACKBONE-SUBSET RESTRICTION
No taxon outside this lineage is inserted.
LOCAL TRIPLET MATRIX → SCOPED COMPLETION + UPGMA → STELAR BACKBONE DP
C is placed near D; old A/B/D topology stays.
Subset DP weights: ORIGINAL genes restricted to Bᵣ
TRIPLET EDGE ASSIGNMENT → DISJOINT PARTITION MATRICES → UPGMA GRAFTING
Score remaining taxa against backbone edges
Each remaining taxon chooses one best backbone edge.
REPEAT FOR r RANDOMIZED ROUNDS → GUIDE-CLADE UNION → FINAL STELAR DP
Each round samples a fresh Bᵣ; rounds are independent, not edits of one guide.
Guides only: no global UPGMA or S1 clades
S-rooted triplets only; same-root duplicates once
S6 --subsetlocal: local backbone completion; partition trees use restricted uncompleted DISCO data (no completion); r=4 by default.
Toy trees are schematic; component icons are not literal reconstructions.
Production DISCO retains components with at least four leaves.
